target: CPU toy expected-L0 basis recovery under identifiable and cancellation-degenerate 2D activation laws
evidence_scope: new independent synthetic worlds; no pretrained weights; ARG-03 168-case protected test stays untouched
strata: 16 rotated-unique-optimum worlds, 16 cancellation-tied-optimum worlds, fixed ahead of outcome generation
row_basis_definition: all unordered linearly independent pairs from candidates; canonical lexicographic tie-break for equal sampled expected L0

generator.rotated: support (1,1),(1,-1), and zero with positive symmetric weights varying by seed; exact optimum directions (1,1),(1,-1)
generator.cancellation: support (1,0),(0,1),(1,1) with equal positive weights and zero with remaining weight, three optima before sampling; expected L0 ties
generator.sampling: Each seed uses independent deterministic seeded PRNG; train and readout streams disjoint; freeze criterion before readout

primary_tests.comparison: train-selected basis vs fixed e1,e2 basis
primary_tests.metric: world-level paired heldout average active-row count reduction
primary_tests.test: independent-world sign flip and Holm 2-test family

primary_tests.metric: world-level indicator whether trained basis belongs to the true maximum-hyperplane-mass optimum set
primary_tests.test: descriptive proportion with world-level binomial interval; no hypothesis of universal recovery

mechanistic_audit: For two distinct optimal bases, compare singleton diagonal mask and whole-block masks under exact rational conjugation R=M2 M1^-1; verify commutator zeros iff invariant; label proof-dependent finite witness.
controls: random candidate basis matched to same dictionary and seeds
root_unit: world seed (n=32); 256 within-seed activation samples are correlated
no_unseal: ARG03-N test.jsonl SHA-256 ddd580... stays untouched
